items.source: Only a single auto-proxy creator should be registered and multiple configuration elements may wish to register different concrete implementations. As such this class delegates to AopConfigUtils which provides a simple escalation protocol. Callers may request a particular auto-proxy creator and know that creator, or a more capable variant thereof, will be registered as a post-processor.
items.translation: 只应注册一个自动代理创建器，而多个配置元素可能希望注册不同的具体实现。因此，该类委托给 AopConfigUtils，后者提供了一个简单的升级协议。调用者可以请求特定的自动代理创建器，并知道该创建器（或其更强大的变体）将被注册为后置处理器。
